definitions.explanation: A type of train service that skips some stations to provide faster travel; faster than local but slower than express.

examples.japanese: {快速|かいそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
{快速|かいそく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{次|つぎ}の{駅|えき}→次の駅：23576_tsuginoeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{止|と}まりません→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: The rapid train doesn't stop at the next station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各停|かくてい}→各停：09214_kakutei⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{快速|かいそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: You'll arrive faster on the rapid than on the local train.

notes:
{快速|かいそく} is a train service type that skips some stations, commonly found on JR and other Japanese railways.

TRAIN SERVICE HIERARCHY (slowest to fastest):
- ⟦{各停|かくてい}→各停：09214_kakutei⟧/⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧: local (all stops)
- {快速|かいそく}: rapid
- ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧: express
- ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧: limited express

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {快速|かいそく}⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧: rapid train
- {快速|かいそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to take a rapid
- {快速|かいそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: a rapid is coming

USAGE:
- No extra fare required on most lines
- Service levels vary by railway company
